hero.h1: Trenchless Sewer Repair in Hinsdale, IL
hero.sub: In Hinsdale, the sewer line often runs under a century-old oak, a stone walk or a garden that took years to grow in. Trenchless repair fixes the pipe through small openings, so most of that stays where it is. Our office is on Spinning Wheel Road.

img.alt: Two J. Blanton plumbers pouring resin into a sewer liner bag to prepare a trenchless pipe lining

trust: 4.7 stars · 5,669+ Google reviews across all locations

blocks.body: Trenchless sewer repair, also called no-dig sewer repair, fixes a damaged pipe without digging a trench along its full length. Instead of opening up your yard from the house to the street, we work through one or two access points and repair the pipe from the inside or replace it in place. There are two main methods: cured-in-place pipe (CIPP) lining and pipe bursting. Both fix the line underground, so what's above it stays untouched.

img.alt: Two J. Blanton plumbers setting up sewer camera and cable equipment beside a home's foundation before a trenchless sewer repair

blocks.intro: Hinsdale homeowners invest a lot in their yards. Trenchless repair respects that investment.

items.body: A liner goes inside the pipe, so there's no trench through the root zone.
Stone walks, pavers and long driveways can usually stay in place.
When roots have opened joints from end to end, lining seals all of them at once.

items.h3: Breaks and Sags Get a Spot Repair First
items.body: A liner follows the pipe. A collapsed or sagging section is fixed before lining.

blocks.h2: Trenchless Sewer Questions From Hinsdale Homeowners

items.q: Can a liner go into a very old clay pipe?
items.preview: Often, if it still holds its shape.
items.answer: Often. If the camera shows the pipe is still round and open, it can be lined. Broken sections may need a spot repair first.

items.q: Will lining hurt our old trees?
items.preview: It avoids digging through the roots.
items.answer: Lining happens inside the existing pipe, so there's no trench through the root zone.

items.q: How long does a sewer liner last?
items.answer: Liners are designed to last for decades, and they have no joints for roots to get through.

items.q: Can trenchless repair be done in winter?
items.answer: Usually. Lining doesn't depend on digging through frozen ground, so many jobs can be done year-round.

items.q: How much does trenchless sewer repair cost in Hinsdale?
items.preview: It depends on length, depth and method. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on how much of the line needs work, the depth, the method and access. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
